source.text: Supplier slip OCR: Meadow Glazes, pale green, batch 17, two tubs. My job-reference line is cropped out of the photo.
Orchard Hall October wedding order: three-tier citrus cake, pale green glaze, delivery before the ceremony. Tasting included in this commission.
Orchard Hall tasting: citrus sponge approved. Keep the bottom tier less sweet so the glaze does not dominate.
Stone Pier cafe hired us for opening-day pastries under a separate order. They want the same pale green glaze but individual pear cakes.
Stone Pier opening trial: pear cakes held their shape for four hours. Increase the pastry count from 60 to 72 for the opening order.
Found the uncropped Meadow Glazes slip: one tub was allocated to the Orchard Hall wedding cake and one to the Stone Pier opening pastries.
Orchard Hall cake assembly checklist: chill all three tiers, fit the support dowels, and reserve the labeled wedding glaze tub.
The Orchard Hall wedding cake reached the venue upright. Photograph the final table placement before returning the transport box.
Wedding cake feedback from Orchard Hall: citrus balance praised; one glaze edge scuffed during table placement. Add a wider carry board to this job's review.
Stone Pier opening-day counter photo: the 72 pear cakes are on trays beside the cafe's launch sign; the delivery docket is signed.
Meadow Glazes reconciliation: charge one batch-17 tub to Orchard Hall wedding and one to Stone Pier opening; neither client should receive the other's delivery fee.
Aquarium clip: filter rattles even after cleaning the impeller. Replacement housing should fit behind the tank lid.

events.reason: The uncropped allocation in c06 confirms that the receipt serves both orders. Link the supplier slip to both without merging the commissions.
